typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Enclosure as string,
		{Client Enclosure Name} as string,
		{Main Feed Circuits - Count} as double,
		{Main Feed Circuits - Billable (kW)} as double,
		{Branch Circuits - Count} as double,
		{Branch Circuits - Billable (kW)} as double,
		{All Circuits - Billing Method} as string,
		{All Circuits - Billable (kW)} as double,
		{All Circuits - Current Commit (kW)} as double,
		{Active Alarms - Low Alarm} as double,
		{Active Alarms - High Warning} as double,
		{Active Alarms - High Alarm} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		ActiveAlarmsHighWarning as double,
		AllCircuitsCurrentCommitkW as double,
		UploadDate as string,
		MainFeedCircuitsBillablekW as double,
		AllCircuitsBillablekW as double,
		Enclosure as string,
		ClientEnclosureName as string,
		FName as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		BranchCircuitsBillablekW as double,
		ActiveAlarmsHighAlarm as double,
		MainFeedCircuitsCount as double,
		BranchCircuitsCount as double,
		AllCircuitsBillingMethod as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ActiveAlarmsHighWarning = {Active Alarms - High Warning},
		AllCircuitsCurrentCommitkW = {All Circuits - Current Commit (kW)},
		UploadDate,
		MainFeedCircuitsBillablekW = {Main Feed Circuits - Billable (kW)},
		AllCircuitsBillablekW = {All Circuits - Billable (kW)},
		Enclosure,
		ClientEnclosureName = {Client Enclosure Name},
		FName,
		EtlUser,
		BranchCircuitsBillablekW = {Branch Circuits - Billable (kW)},
		ActiveAlarmsHighAlarm = {Active Alarms - High Alarm},
		MainFeedCircuitsCount = {Main Feed Circuits - Count},
		BranchCircuitsCount = {Branch Circuits - Count},
		AllCircuitsBillingMethod = {All Circuits - Billing Method}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
